caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, patterned water, gold ground, a great ark crowded with human figures and animals adrift on bands of patterned waves, birds circling above and a dragon-tailed serpent rising from the sea, gold sky and dark water, gold, lapis blue, cinnabar red, malachite green, soot
